I added a 0.25s sleep after each sandbox call in `tests/test_payments.py`. The limit of 5 requests per second means calls must be at least 0.2s apart, so 0.25s leaves some room. The delay is stored in a named constant, `SANDBOX_CALL_INTERVAL_S`, with a comment explaining the rate limit. I haven't run the test.

The sleep also runs after the last call. That adds 0.25s to the test, but it keeps a following test that uses the sandbox from going over the limit.

I also saved the 5-requests-per-second limit to the project's EngramDB memory, so future tests that call the sandbox will space their calls too.
